description: Release APK packs and games to the monorepo
deviation_notes: 15 tasks more than the estimate: the RPG skin for the Primary pages (Phase 3b), the merge route through lane-f instead of a push to master, the Mitr font, the parchment demo on www, and the no-hero silhouette. The monorepo re-export of the 2D setting remains as TD-26. The platform port track is no longer a dependency: the release used the port branch, and the two open port tasks (the graph refresh and the pull request) are cutover work in the monorepo.
